title: selaginella davidii subsp. gebaueriana
intro: Selaginella davidii subsp. gebaueriana, commonly known as the Tibetan spikemoss, is a species of spikemoss in the family Selaginellaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a popular choice for natural remedies. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella davidii subsp. gebaueriana include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and potentially inhibiting cancer cell growth. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
